text: alright cool now im pretty sure we said at the top of this that the map data was farts and dicks, i can clearly see that you have a new blank chunk but its rendering in clash with the loaded world that was there previously and so its all a mishmash of shit, so i still cant really evaluate the tool
resolution: The mishmash was the editor's viewport mounting zig-out/game/editor/main.gamefile — the condemned hmsc sandbox bake — under the new painted chunk. Fixed both ends (910961f15): world_loader now BLANK-BOOTS when the game file is MISSING (constructor.blankScene: empty slices, null optionals, default env — the world is exactly the live layers: painted map + placed pieces + brush beam over nothing; a corrupt file still fails loudly), and cart/editor points at its OWN fresh path (world.gamefile, doesn't exist yet), leaving the old junk on disk but unmounted; the future compile lane writes the new path. NEEDS A FRAMEWORK REBUILD (loader+constructor are host-side); world gamefile/mapfile test steps green. Note: the painted-map.rmap you stroked during testing still auto-loads on arm — delete zig-out/game/editor/painted-map.rmap if you want the canvas fully virgin.
